note: D2 reroll price escalation and cap (under the spinning_shrine mutator): a spin costs SHOP_COSTS.reroll 2 plus SHOP_REROLL_STEP 1 per spin already taken, so three spins take 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 of a 14-bloom purse (the first cleanse pins the 14, the last pins the 5 left as 5 + 1 = 6). Five is exactly the fourth spin.s price (2 + 3 * 1), so the fourth reroll is refused by SHOP_REROLL_CAP alone and not by the purse - the runner fails on any illegal event, so the refusal itself is asserted in tests/test_economy.gd. Exclusion is against what is on the counter, never the history: the third spin lands back on the floor.s own root_wall / [bloom_surge, verdant_pulse] draw
